jobs.title: Director of Brand & Marketing (m/f/d)

titleByLocale.it: Direttore del marchio e del marketing (m/f/d)
titleByLocale.fr: Directeur/Directrice de la marque et du marketing (H/F/D)

jobs.description:
Your key responsibilities

  • As Director of Brand & Marketing, you will have overall responsibility for the Badrutt's Palace brand and marketing across all touchpoints, including the hotel, restaurants, bars, spa, retail, and events.

  • You will continuously evolve the brand positioning, identity, tone of voice, and visual expression, ensuring a consistent and exceptional brand experience.

  • Leading the Brand & Marketing team, you will foster a culture of brand excellence, cultural awareness, and creativity.

  • The brand's entire digital ecosystem—including website experience, social media, content, paid media, and SEO/GEO/SEM—will be under your strategic direction.

  • You will further develop the hotel's distinctive social media and content strategy, placing cultural relevance and a clearly defined luxury brand code at the heart of every initiative.

  • As the owner of the CRM strategy, you will strengthen guest relationships, drive loyalty, and create long-term value across the luxury guest journey.

  • Relevant KPIs will be defined, monitored, and managed by you to ensure transparency, measure performance, and deliver sustainable business impact.

  • You will lead external agencies and strategic partners with a clear focus on quality, creativity, and brand consistency.


• What you bring to the job

  • You have a refined understanding of ultra-luxury, aesthetics, language, and brand excellence.

  • Several years of experience in a senior Brand and/or Marketing leadership role within a premium or luxury environment enable you to shape brands with confidence and strategic vision.

  • You have a proven track record of leading teams at management or executive level.

  • Your expertise spans the full digital ecosystem, including social media, content, performance marketing, web, and CRM.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, combined with strong decision-making and execution capabilities, enables you to deliver measurable business impact.

  • You are confident in managing and influencing senior internal and external stakeholders.

  • You communicate fluently in English; proficiency in German is an advantage.

  • You thrive in a demanding, seasonal luxury hospitality environment and embrace the pace and expectations that come with it.


Our offer

  • A permanent, year-round position in one of the most unique Brand leadership roles in international luxury hospitality.

  • Membership of the Executive Committee (ExCom), with direct influence on the brand and the overall guest experience.

  • The opportunity to shape one of the world's most iconic luxury hotels, defined by exceptional quality, heritage, and excellence.

  • An inspiring working environment in St. Moritz, offering long-term career prospects and development opportunities at Executive level.

If you are inspired by this exceptional leadership opportunity in the world of international luxury hospitality, we look forward to receiving your complete online application.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

Badrutt's Palace Hotel will never request payment or financial information during the recruitment process. All official communication is sent exclusively from email addresses ending in @badruttspalace.com. If you receive any request for payment or suspicious communication, please disregard it and contact us directly through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Le vostre responsabilità chiave

- Come direttore del Brand & Marketing, avrete la responsabilità generale del marchio e del marketing del Badrutt's Palace in tutti i touchpoint, compresi l'hotel, i ristoranti, i bar, le terme, i negozi e gli eventi.

- Evolverete continuamente il posizionamento del marchio, l'identità, il tono della voce e l'espressione visiva, garantendo un'esperienza di marca coerente ed eccezionale.

- Conducendo il team Brand & Marketing, promuoverai una cultura dell'eccellenza del marchio, della consapevolezza culturale e della creatività.

- L'intero ecosistema digitale del marchio, compresa l'esperienza del sito web, i social media, i contenuti, i media a pagamento e SEO/GEO/SEM. saranno sotto la vostra direzione strategica.

- Svilupperete ulteriormente la strategia di social media e contenuti distintivi dell'hotel, ponendo la rilevanza culturale e un codice di lusso chiaramente definito al centro di ogni iniziativa.

- Come proprietario della strategia CRM, potrai rafforzare le relazioni con gli ospiti, guidare la lealtà e creare valore a lungo termine attraverso il viaggio degli ospiti di lusso.

- I KPI pertinenti saranno definiti, monitorati e gestiti da voi per garantire trasparenza, misurare le prestazioni e garantire un impatto commerciale sostenibile.

- Condurrà agenzie esterne e partner strategici con un chiaro focus sulla qualità, creatività e coerenza del marchio.

• Cosa si porta al lavoro

- Hai una raffinata comprensione dell'ultra-lusso, estetica, linguaggio ed eccellenza del marchio.

- Diversi anni di esperienza in un ruolo di leader senior Brand e/o Marketing in un ambiente premium o di lusso consentono di modellare i marchi con fiducia e visione strategica.

- Hai un curriculum di team leader a livello di direzione o esecutivo.

- La tua esperienza abbraccia l'intero ecosistema digitale, inclusi i social media, i contenuti, il marketing delle prestazioni, il web e il CRM.

- Una mentalità imprenditoriale, unita a forti capacità decisionali ed esecutive, consente di ottenere un impatto commerciale misurabile.

- Siete fiduciosi nel gestire e influenzare gli stakeholder interni ed esterni senior.

- Lei comunica fluentemente in inglese; la competenza in tedesco è un vantaggio.

- Si prospera in un ambiente di lusso esigente e stagionale e abbracciare il ritmo e le aspettative che vengono con esso.

La nostra offerta

- Una posizione permanente, tutto l'anno in uno dei ruoli di leadership più unici Brand nell'ospitalità di lusso internazionale.

- Composizione del Comitato Esecutivo (ExCom), con influenza diretta sul marchio e l'esperienza complessiva degli ospiti.

- L'opportunità di creare uno degli hotel di lusso più iconici al mondo, definito da qualità, patrimonio e eccellenza eccezionali.

- Un ambiente di lavoro stimolante a St. Moritz, che offre prospettive di carriera a lungo termine e opportunità di sviluppo a livello esecutivo.

Se vi ispirate a questa eccezionale opportunità di leadership nel mondo dell'ospitalità di lusso internazionale, non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione online completa.

Avviso sulle frodi in materia di assunzione

Il Badrutt's Palace Hotel non richiederà mai il pagamento o informazioni finanziarie durante il processo di reclutamento. Tutte le comunicazioni ufficiali vengono inviate esclusivamente da indirizzi e-mail che terminano in @ badruttsgalace.com. Se ricevi qualsiasi richiesta di pagamento o comunicazione sospetta, ti preghiamo di ignorarlo e contattarci direttamente attraverso il nostro sito ufficiale.

jobs.title: Assistant Head of Technical Services (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Your key responsibilities

As Assistant Head of Technical Services, you support the Head of Technical Services in the operational management and ongoing development of all technical areas within our property. You help ensure the reliable, safe, and efficient operation of our infrastructure and assume responsibility for the department in their absence.

  • Coordination and supervision of daily technical operations, maintenance activities, and repairs.

  • Involvement in the planning and implementation of maintenance, investment, renovation, and construction projects.

  • Support in the organisation of the technical team’s daily assignments and in leading and developing team members.

  • Deputising for the Head of Technical Services during their absence.

  • Coordination and supervision of external service providers and contractors.

  • Support with cost monitoring, procurement, and investment planning.

  • Ensuring compliance with legal requirements, safety standards, and internal policies.

  • Close collaboration with all departments and contribution to the continuous improvement of technical processes, energy efficiency, and resource management.


• What you bring to the job

  • Completed technical training, ideally complemented by further education in building services engineering, facility management, or a related discipline.

  • Several years of professional experience in technical services or facility management, ideally within the hospitality sector or a similarly complex environment.

  • Experience in coordinating employees or small teams; initial leadership experience is an advantage.

  • Broad technical knowledge of building services, maintenance, energy efficiency, occupational safety, and technical infrastructure.

  • Experience in supporting or coordinating maintenance, renovation, or construction projects.

  • A structured, hands-on, and solution-oriented approach, combined with strong organisational and communication skills.

  • Confident use of digital tools.

  • A recognised qualification as a Safety Officer (SIBE) and/or Contact Person for Occupational Safety (KOPAS) is required.

  • A combination of at least two of the following languages is required: English, German, and Italian.

  • Please note: You must be a Swiss or EU national to apply for this position.


Our offer

  • Permanent position, starting date by arrangement

  • 5-day working week averaging 43.5 hours, with 5 weeks' holiday and 6 public holidays per year.

  • 13th month's salary from the start of employment (pro rata temporis).

  • To begin with, accommodation in one of our new staff houses.

  • Meals available in our new and modern staff restaurant.

  • Opportunity to work in an attractive environment with development and career growth opportunities.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

Badrutt's Palace Hotel will never request payment or financial information during the recruitment process. All official communication is sent exclusively from email addresses ending in @badruttspalace.com. If you receive any request for payment or suspicious communication, please disregard it and contact us directly through our official website.

Als Assistant Director of Food & Beverage unterstützen Sie den Director of Food & Beverage in der Führung und Weiterentwicklung des gesamten F&B-Bereichs. Gemeinsam mit den Führungskräften sorgen Sie für ein erstklassiges Gästeerlebnis und reibungslose Abläufe in unseren Outlets.

  • In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Abteilungsleitungen begleiten Sie den operativen Betrieb von bis zu elf F&B-Outlets und den dazugehörigen Supportabteilungen.

  • Die Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung der F&B-Strategie, unserer Konzepte und Prozesse unterstützen Sie aktiv.

  • Als Gastgeberpersönlichkeit sind Sie präsent, pflegen den Kontakt zu unseren Gästen und kümmern sich aufmerksam um ihre Anliegen. Gleichzeitig koordinieren Sie die Zusammenarbeit mit den verschiedenen Abteilungen des Hotels und achten auf die Einhaltung gesetzlicher und betrieblicher Vorgaben.

  • Bei Abwesenheit des Director of Food & Beverage übernehmen Sie die operative Verantwortung für den Bereich.

Das bringen Sie mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Food & Beverage einer internationalen Luxushotellerie, idealerweise in einer vergleichbaren Position.

  • Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung internationaler Teams.

  • Ausgeprägte operative Kompetenz und ein gutes Verständnis für betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge.

  • Kenntnisse in Budgetierung, Kostenkontrolle und Ressourcenplanung.

  • Eine souveräne, gastgeberorientierte Persönlichkeit mit Freude am direkten Gästekontakt.

  • Eine selbstständige, entscheidungsfreudige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse; weitere Sprachen sind von Vorteil.

Unser Angebot

  • Eine unbefristete Jahresstelle in einer vielseitigen Führungsfunktion der internationalen Luxushotellerie.

  • Die Möglichkeit, die Weiterentwicklung unseres F&B-Bereichs aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Ein attraktives Arbeitsumfeld in St. Moritz mit individuellen Entwicklungs- und Karrieremöglichkeiten.

  • Zu Beginn eine Unterkunft in einem unserer neuen Mitarbeiterhäuser.

  • Einen 13. Monatslohn ab Beginn des Arbeitsverhältnisses, anteilsmässig ausbezahlt, sowie fünf Wochen Ferien und sechs Feiertage pro Jahr.

Wenn Sie eine interessante, anspruchsvolle und vielseitige Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen Umfeld schätzen und sich einem gut eingespielten Team anschliessen möchten, dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre vollständige Online Bewerbung.

jobs.description:
Your key responsibilities

As part of our culinary team at Chesa Veglia, you will play an essential role in preparing our signature pizzas, which our guests highly appreciate and are central to what we are known for.
• Your responsibilities will include:

  • Preparing high-quality pizzas, focaccia and other specialties according to our standards

  • Supporting the ordering and stock management process

  • Operating and maintaining the wood-fired oven

  • Ensuring compliance with kitchen hygiene and safety regulations (HACCP)

  • Maintaining consistently high product quality

  • Working efficiently and ensuring effective time management

• What you bring to the job

To succeed in this position, you ideally bring:

  • Completed professional training as a Chef or equivalent culinary qualification

  • Several years of professional experience as a Pizzaiolo

  • Good spoken Italian and English

  • Strong quality awareness and attention to detail

  • Ability to work under pressure and enjoy working as part of a team

  • High level of commitment, reliability and flexibility

Our offer

  • Fixed-term seasonal position from the beginning of December 2026 until the end of March 2027, with the possibility of returning for future seasons

  • An average 5-day working week of 43.5 hours

  • 5 weeks of holiday and 6 public holidays per year

  • 13th-month salary from the start of employment (pro rata temporis)

  • Staff accommodation in one of our employee residences, subject to availability

  • Meals available in our modern staff restaurant

  • An attractive and international working environment with opportunities for professional development


If you are looking for an interesting, challenging, and varied role in a dynamic environment and would like to join a well-established team, we look forward to receiving your complete online application.


Recruitment Fraud Warning
Badrutt's Palace Hotel will never request payment or financial information during the recruitment process. All official communication is sent exclusively from email addresses ending in @badruttspalace.com. If you receive any request for payment or suspicious communication, please disregard it and contact us directly through our official website.

  • Preparare pizze, focacce e altre specialità di alta qualità secondo i nostri standard

  • Supporto al processo di gestione degli ordini e delle scorte

  • Utilizzo e manutenzione del forno a legna

  • Garantire il rispetto delle norme di igiene e sicurezza in cucina (HACCP)

  • Mantenere una qualità del prodotto costantemente elevata

  • Lavorare in modo efficiente e garantire una gestione efficace del tempo

• Cosa porti con te nel lavoro

Per avere successo in questa posizione, idealmente dovresti avere:

  • Formazione professionale completata come chef o qualifica culinaria equivalente

  • Diversi anni di esperienza professionale come pizzaiolo

  • Buona conoscenza dell'italiano e dell'inglese parlato

  • Forte sensibilità per la qualità e attenzione ai dettagli

  • Capacità di lavorare sotto pressione e di apprezzare il lavoro di squadra

  • Elevato livello di impegno, affidabilità e flessibilità

  • Posizione stagionale a tempo determinato dall'inizio di dicembre 2026 fino alla fine di marzo 2027, con possibilità di rientro per le stagioni future

  • Una settimana lavorativa media di 5 giorni per un totale di 43,5 ore

  • 5 settimane di ferie e 6 giorni festivi all'anno

  • Tredicesima mensilità fin dall'inizio del rapporto di lavoro (pro rata temporis)

  • Alloggio per il personale in una delle nostre residenze per dipendenti, soggetto a disponibilità

  • Un ambiente di lavoro stimolante e internazionale con opportunità di sviluppo professionale
